Punk Rocker 2 summary

The rebellious spirit of the underground has crossed the Atlantic and taken over New York in Punk Rocker 2. This high energy release by Nolimit City drops players into a graffiti covered subway station where anarchy reigns supreme. The action takes place on a six reel grid that expands to offer up to 46,656 ways to win. You can jump straight into the mosh pit and play for free directly on Playin to experience the chaotic atmosphere yourself.

Base Game Mechanics and Features

Surviving the subway means embracing the unpredictable modifiers that can trigger on any spin. Base game wins are formed by connecting matching symbols from left to right. The chaos escalates quickly with the introduction of the xWays mechanic, which reveals multiple instances of the same symbol to massively expand your win ways. The base game is also packed with explosives like Molotov Wilds that turn all positions above them into wilds, alongside Pipe Bomb Wilds that cascade into even more wild symbols to force huge connections.

Bonus Rounds and Free Spins

The real riot begins when you land the bonus symbols. Catching two scatters triggers Riot Respins, locking wild reels in place for a second chance at massive combinations. Three or more scatters unlock the main free spin tiers. DisOBEY Spins give you eight spins with three Jumping Wilds and a top Train Enhancer. Upgrading to ChAos Spins adds a fourth Jumping Wild and activates a second Train Enhancer at the bottom of the grid. The ultimate tier is the Mass Transit BBQ Spins, which unleashes a Burning Cart that converts regular jumping wilds into persistent multiplier machines. Mastering these complex feature levels is the perfect way to prepare for a free slot tournament where you can battle for real rewards.

Volatility Rating and Potential

Nolimit City has given this rebellious sequel an Extreme volatility rating. The mathematical model is highly aggressive but comes with an enormous maximum win potential of up to 30,144 times your base bet. Because the swings can be brutal, using virtual currency is the smartest way to learn the game. Playing with your Playin coins allows you to test out the different Train Enhancers and wild interactions without risking your own bankroll.

Game Features

Riot Respins

Riot Respins are awarded when landing 2 Bonus symbols. Bonus symbols are converted to Molotov Wilds and lock the reels. All Reels with Wilds are locked. Additional Bonus symbols landing during Riot Respins award an additional respin and are converted into Molotov Wilds, after payout.

DisOBEY Spins

Bonus symbols award 8 DisOBEY Spins, played with 3 Jumping Wild Symbols and the Top Train Enhancer.

ChAos Spins

Bonus symbols award 8 ChAos Spins, played with 4 Jumping Wild Symbols and both Train Enhancers.

Mass Transit BBQ Spins

Bonus symbols award 8 Mass Transit BBQ Spins, played with 4 Jumping Wilds, both Train Enhancers and the Burning cart stopping every spin.

Jumping Wilds

Jumping Wild symbols and Burning Jumping Wild symbols are active during Free Spins. They change positions on the reels between each spin. All Wild Multiplier enhancers triggered by Burning Jumping Wild symbols will become persistent during the remainder of Free Spins. Wild Multipliers are additive.

xWays®

An xWays® symbol can hold 2 to 4 of the same symbol inside and all xWays® symbols will show the same symbol. When xWays® in base game are expanded to 4 high, the symbol can be super expanded up to 20 high. xWays® Mystery Symbol is activated in main game and Free Spins. xWays® in Free Spins will expand to 4 high and contains 4, 6 or 8 of the same symbol.

Train Enhancers

Train Enhancers are awarded when a Jumping Wild Symbol or Burning Jumping Wild symbol is on the same reel. Top Train Enhancers: Wild Multiplier, xWays®, Molotov Wilds, Extra spins, all reels become 6 high, Upgrade Free Spins, Enable Bottom Train Enhancer. Bottom Train Enhancers: Wild Multiplier, Extra spins, Burning Jumping Wild. If the Burning cart contains a Burning Jumping Wild then it will convert all Jumping Wilds into Burning Jumping Wilds on it’s reel. Wild Multipliers are additive.

Wild Symbols

Molotov Wild turns all positions above into Wild symbols. Molotov Wilds may land in main game, Riot Respins and may be activated during Free Spins. Pipe Bomb Wild symbols contain 2 to 4 Wild symbols and turns all positions above into Pipe Bomb Wilds of the same size. Pipe Bomb Wild may land in main game and Riot Respins.

xBet™

At a cost of 2 times the base bet, the player is guaranteed a special symbol Bonus, xWays®, Super xWays®, Molotov Wilds, Pipe Bomb Wild on reel 2.

We Want You

The max payout of the game is 30,144 times the base bet. When the total win exceeds this amount the game round will end and 30,144 times the base bet is awarded.

Nolimit Bonus Buy

Buy your way straight into the different bonus features, ranging from 100 to 3,000 times the base bet.

The Nolimit Bonus feature may however be removed in some regulated markets.

Nolimit Booster

Buy a specific game feature in the Nolimit Bonus tool. The total cost for the activated feature will be charged from your balance for each spin.

The Nolimit Booster feature may however be removed in some regulated markets.

Action Spins

Get your adrenaline flowing and play your regular bonus rounds in HYPER MODE! ‘Action Spins’ is a new optional feature that ushers in an innovative way to play a high volume of rounds of the Base Game or Multiple Bonus rounds in a rapid and exhilarating way!

The Action Spins feature may however be removed in some regulated markets.

Game xMechanics

xWays®

xWays® unlocks unprecedented win potential for players. Usually seen in a fixed Ways game, any xWays symbols that land reveals a stack of the same symbol, increasing the ways available to win, and when working alongside some of the other mechanics available in this series, such as xNudge or xSplit, can pave the way for some huge wins. xWays® first made an appearance in Pixies Vs Pirates, although many players will more likely recognise this mechanic from Punk Rocker, an early 2020 release. Alongside these two releases, xWays has made an appearance in a host of other NolimitCity games, including Dragon Tribe, East Coast vs West Coast, and San Quentin – the early 2021 release which rocked the community with news of a 150,000x maximum win availability.

xBet®

At an extra cost per spin, the player gets an increased chance of getting into the Bonus Modes. The way this happens varies from game to game. The payout for each symbol is not affected.
